page: UpCloud GPU-24xCPU-480GB-2xH100 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 24 vCPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory. The system is powered by an Intel Xeon 8462Y+ processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture, operating at a base frequency of 2.0 GHz across 24 physical cores with a single thread per core. The primary hardware highlight is the inclusion of two NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs, providing a combined 160 GB of high-bandwidth video memory. This instance does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be handled via network-attached volumes.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance profiles across multiple domains. The server achieves top-tier results in single-threaded bzip3 decompression at 15.63 GB/sec and LLM inference using a small 135M model, processing prompts at 10457.59 tokens/sec and generating text at 366.07 tokens/sec. Memory performance is also strong, with read-only small block bandwidth reaching 4086.55 GB/sec and large block write bandwidth at 110.72 GB/sec. CPU-bound tasks are supported by advanced instruction sets, including Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512, which contribute to a PassMark CPU score of 55980.84 and a database operations score of 24760.33.

Given the high-density hardware profile featuring dual enterprise-grade H100 GPUs and 480 GB of RAM, this server represents a specialized tier of resource allocation. The absence of local storage is a notable tradeoff, requiring external storage configurations. This server is highly suited for workloads requiring massive parallel processing capabilities and large memory footprints, such as large language model inference, deep learning training, high-performance computing, complex scientific simulations, and memory-intensive database operations.
